notes.title: Grief 4 of 5
notes.content:
I've been busy for the whole month of October!

[h2]New Mini Games[/h2]
Anger - Let's test your patience.
Bargaining - Let's puzzle you.
Depression - Let's hurt you.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
Global - You type di for ぢ and ヂ to be more in line with real keyboards.
Global - You type du for づ and ヅ to be more in line with real keyboards.
Global - If you've answered yes to review the previous phase, you will continue to earn credits and experience. Previously, you would not.
Global - Slightly more optimized card generation.
Global - Cards attack times are back to 10.
First Menu - No Pressure is now called "Study" and Challenge is now called "Timed". (Thank you Wheat thin for the idea)
First Menu - You no longer choose your difficulty when you start a new game. It's automatically on Study.
First Menu - Fixed the copyright button
First Menu - Added random people walking towards the city
Home - Table of Contents applied to every book
Office Hotfix - The snake game is hidden until you actually access the snake game.
Office - The snake game now remembers the last four cards from the previous session (unless you leave the room).
Port - You now have to choose your difficulty through the number of rebirths. Easy (0 rebirths), Fair, and Hard (4+ rebirths)
School - After the school battle, you will end up back in the Hiragana/Katakana/Both menu. (Thank you Wheat thin for the idea)
School - Test 3, rebirths block your view in different ways.
School - Hiragana- a, ka, and sa has a little bit of burst through the wall.
School - Katakana - a, ka, and sa feature different layouts of the room.
School - Hiragana - ta and na now have 100% more rotations.
School - Katakana - ta, na, and ha now seat you in different places in the coffee shop.
Story Hotfix - Fixed the numpad scoring
Story - You can get to know Tashawn and Wooly better, because Japanese words open them up more.
World - Cleaner, Grid-like interface
World - You can change your difficulty at the school menu

notes.title: The First Update
notes.content:
New Game - We have a Prelude now!

Load Game - You will always spawn at the World.
Load Game - You can clone and rename your save file.
Load Game - You start with full health instead of the previously saved HP.

Battle Results - J and K shortcuts for scrolling.

Hiragana Lessons - Made a new scene... mostly because I'm uncomfortable with the current one.
Hiragana Lessons - Digraph and Small tsu lessons

Katakana Lessons - Now starring Jason with his messy room and Piper at the coffee shop. They're gonna be part of the story.
Katakana Lessons - Digraph and Small tsu lessons

World Screen - Has keyboard shortcuts for Home, School, and Lessons.
World Screen - Has a Story mode. The prelude and episode 1 are available here. Haven't written the whole story yet though and Episode 1 has only started.

Home - Has a study mode! You can choose to heal w/ Study or Sleep.

Port - Took away the Loading Bay. I liked developing it but it's so boring to actually play.

Raceway - If you type "Katakana", you can type the Katakana version of Iroha.

Office - Now has a snake game.

Twitch Setting - Has a button to point you to the tmi url.

I'm not testing rebirths b/c mostly focusing on the first playthrough, but I've balanced it as follows.

Rebirth 1 - You now start with 2 HP as soon as you rebirth.
Rebirth 2 - Full Furi
Rebirth 3 - No Visual Feedback on cards
Rebirth 5 - Cards hit twice as hard
Rebirth 7 - Backspace hurts. (completely untested, will probably break the game)
Rebirth 9 - Kanji (completely untested, will probably break the game)
